title: Transforming Heart Disease Prediction with Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: arXiv:2608.18687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Heart disease remains the leading cause of mortality globally, necessitating early and accurate detection to improve patient outcomes. This research focuses on the predictive analysis of heart disease using machine learning (ML) techniques, comparing the performance of multiple classifiers to identify the most accurate and least error-prone method. Two datasets from UCI and Kaggle repositories were utilized, each containing 14 attributes related to heart health indicators. Techniques including J48, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Simple Cart, Bagging, Decision Stump, AdaBoost, Artificial Neural Networks, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) were applied. Evaluation metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Relative Absolute Error (RAE), accuracy, precision, recall, and F-measure were used for performance comparison. Results revealed that SVM achieved the highest performance on the UCI dataset, while Simple Cart performed best on the Kaggl

translated_title: 利用先进机器学习技术革新心脏病预测
translated_abstract: 心脏病仍然是全球死亡率的主要原因，早期准确检测对于改善患者预后至关重要。本研究聚焦于使用机器学习（ML）技术进行心脏病的预测分析，比较多种分类器的性能，以识别最准确且错误率最低的方法。研究使用了来自UCI和Kaggle数据库的两个数据集，每个数据集包含14个与心脏健康指标相关的属性。应用了J48、朴素贝叶斯、逻辑回归、简单决策树、Bagging、决策树桩、AdaBoost、人工神经网络和支持向量机（SVM）等技术。评估指标包括平均绝对误差（MAE）、相对绝对误差（RAE）、准确率、精确率、召回率和F值，用于性能比较。结果显示，SVM在UCI数据集上取得了最高性能，而简单决策树在Kaggle数据集上表现最佳。
tldr: 本研究通过比较多种机器学习分类器，发现SVM和简单决策树分别在UCI和Kaggle数据集上实现最佳心脏病预测性能，为精准医疗提供了高效诊断工具。
en_tdlr: This study compares multiple machine learning classifiers and finds that SVM and Simple Cart achieve optimal heart disease prediction performance on UCI and Kaggle datasets, respectively, offering efficient diagnostic tools for precision medicine.
